reviewType: Independent read-only source review; no test execution in this review
checks: Account-save GET no longer shares write admission, preserving cross-account first-login reads.
PUT admission remains after existing session, account, origin and CSRF guards.
Write admission is per-account and bounded to eight requests and a 32 MiB weighted request budget; unknown lengths reserve the worst-case allowance.
Request length validation and readBytes body limits remain enforced; admission released in finally.
Revision CAS, operation IDs, R2 exact metadata/hash checks and lost-ack recovery are unchanged.
Initial cloud-read retry is read-only and bounded by three attempts and a 15 second budget, with capped backoff.
Session generation checks prevent superseded responses/retries from mounting a stale game or issuing further reads.
401/403/409, session_changed, csrf_failed and invalid_response do not enter transient retry.
Failure does not invent an empty cloud save, repeat authentication or overwrite a saved record.
Regression tests cover different-account held writes plus reads, concurrent writes, same-account safety, slot release, budget limits and client cancellation.
